workflow: All three independent explorations use only the original front character appearance reference. Finished scene references are analyzed for composition and motion, not passed back as image generation references.

records.prompt:
Create a BRAND NEW complete landscape 16:9 commercial 3D product poster background. Use ONLY the attached ORIGINAL character reference to preserve identity. Never reference any prior generated scene. Keep the exact pearl-white sphere, glossy black oval visor with two white oval eyes, thin antenna, orange metal side hinges, ORIGINAL short tapered white flipper arms, thin warm lower seam, and the original small chest orange symbol and dark wordmark as pictured.

Art direction: dynamic asymmetrical diagonal composition with bold near/far scale contrast, not two subjects lined up statically. One LARGE smooth silver Bitcoin coin in the lower foreground (x43–72%, y42–92%), coin tilted at an energetic 25-degree diagonal with a three-quarter side bevel, fully visible circular silhouette and orange enamel Bitcoin symbol. Simple smooth silver face and beveled edge, absolutely no brushed lines, concentric machining, scratches, knurling or grain. Behind it and ABOVE TO THE RIGHT a spherical robot (x69–95%, y12–63%) visibly flying/hopping diagonally up-right, whole body rolled 15 degrees clockwise and slightly pitched; clear gaze toward coin and camera. This is a lively mid-motion pose created by the tilted body, flight height and perspective, not by deforming limbs. The two ORIGINAL flippers are asymmetrically splayed modestly at their hinges as a friendly balancing motion, one tilted outward around 25 degrees, the other relaxed around 15 degrees, with natural short mechanical joints. Neither arm touches, grips, rests on, bears weight on, reaches across, or presses the coin. Both original rigid flipper shapes and connection positions remain intact. No fingers or human arms. Maintain a clear air gap. Chest decal fully visible and undistorted.

A low camera angle with strong perspective and depth makes the near coin large and the far robot lively. All subjects inside the frame with comfortable margins, no cropped antenna/coin/arms. Calm left 0–38% charcoal space for later typography. Entire set rendered together on a perfectly smooth seamless dark graphite studio FLOOR with no visible texture, no grain, no concrete, no rough micro-patterns. Smooth restrained broad reflections and soft physically convincing shadows separated under coin and hovering robot reinforce depth and motion. Charcoal background, neutral pearl white, clean satin-smooth silver, selective #FF8200 orange. Large upper-left softbox and tight clean edge highlights, natural contrast; no gritty/dark noise, no distressed texture. No calculator, computer, icon cards, additional coins, speed lines, light trails, particles, starbursts, extra props or fake glow. Do not generate headline, caption, slogan, independent logo or watermark. Preserve only the original robot chest decal from the original reference.

Theme: digital assets in motion. One large three-dimensional Ethereum double-pyramid diamond token sculpted in smooth silver and translucent dark glass hovers in the lower-right foreground, x55–76%, y47–90%, tilted 20 degrees with a single orange bevel accent. Behind and higher, the robot banks upward toward the left, body rolled -15 degrees, x72–94%, y13–59%, gaze toward the token. Its original flippers spread naturally 15–25 degrees to balance flight, not touching token. Low camera with slight diagonal perspective, clear gap between both shapes. One thin tapered warm-orange curved flight wake recedes from behind the robot toward the lower-right background, never wrapping its body. Foreground token stays sharply defined, background wake and far horizon softly motion blurred. A spacious near-black studio void with seamless satin floor, low controlled reflection. Do not add coin stacks, cards or any other prop.

Theme: reading cryptocurrency markets. The robot flies from upper-left toward lower-right CAMERA with a lively 3/4 angle, rolled 12 degrees clockwise, large right-side x65–93%, y20–78%, flippers at natural asymmetric modest hinge angles. TWO small charcoal beveled icon cards accompany it, clearly secondary, staggered with perspective at x52–65%, y19–41% (three simple silver/orange candlestick pictograms) and x50–63%, y53–74% (a single silver/orange Bitcoin symbol). No words or numeric performance claims. Cards are about 15% of robot body size and no more than two, do not surround or overlap face. A single smoothly curved tapered orange flight wake trails leftward behind the robot in lower-middle, soft controlled background directional blur, suggesting a swift glide. Strong camera perspective and near/far depth, face and chest clear. Background charcoal studio gradient, seamless smooth floor with soft subtle shadow/reflection, no physical coin or computer.
